rule_mapping: S1 = population rhythm (crucible.population.core): an individual of the default profile (segment shares as population.core, mean gap log-normal around 7 h (heavy) or 13 h (light), sd 0.45, gaps x Exponential(1) / (0.6 + 0.8 sat), waking day start ~ N(7 h, 55 min), length ~ N(16 h, 50 min), session_start = sigmoid of pop.decision.session_start at attention_ratio 1, satisfaction 0.5, habit 0, experience 0, not woken, in_commitment for employed individuals (68%) inside a 9:00 +- 50 min, 8 h +- 40 min window); P(active on a day) = share of 20,000 simulated individual-days with at least one started session, the same for every user. S2 = C2 return rule: return gaps Exponential(mean gap_mean_s * exp(-gap_sat*(sat - 0.5))) within a 16 h waking day, P(active) = 1 - exp(-16 h / gap). S = the better of S1 and S2 on the primary metric; both reported. Dynamic long-horizon: forward simulation of test users over 2022-05-01..05-08 from their observed history before 05-01; a simulated active day adds the user's mean rows and sessions per active day observed before 05-01 (users without an active day before 05-01: the population means); measure = mean daily |simulated - observed active rate|, plus the total variation distance of the number of active days per user

extra.long_horizon_kind: dynamic: forward simulation 2022-05-01..05-08 of the test users, mean daily |simulated - observed active rate|; also the TV distance of active-day counts
